# Load Packages

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins) # data
library(brms) # run bayesian model
library(cmdstanr) # cmdstan backend 
```


# Load data

```{r}

data <- read.csv("jasongeller/data.csv") # load in data file from file

```

## Run Model

Now we will run this Bayesian model

```{r}

model_normal <- brm(body_mass_g ~ flipper_length_mm,
  family = gaussian(),
  backend="cmdstanr", 
  data = penguins
)

```
